title: Fuzz window and divider resizes: every terminal ends at the grid its view fits, and the drawn grid follows the view during each drag
why: Lawrence 2026-10-29 (felt 1e): 'there are resize bugs where the terminal doesnt resize properly, make sure to fuzz it out. and it needs to be super fluid, like i resize, and the terminal immediately resizes.' A seeded random sequence of corner, edge, tiny, burst, out-and-back, held and minimum-size window drags and divider drags, with one terminal streaming output and one opened with New Terminal Tab (Ctrl-`), must leave every terminal's grid, fitted grid, drawn grid, daemon screen and PTY at the size its view fits; the step reports how long the drawn and owner grids trail the view during the drags.

steps.title: set-up: the window at 55% x 60% of the screen

steps.text: for i in $(seq 1 200000); do echo rz-${nonce}-$i; sleep 0.01; done

steps.title: seeds 1-10: 12 random window and divider resizes each
the right PTY has the final grid
